specification_error_found_and_resolved.symptom: check-alignment scored this specification 0/100 and could not associate any test with any requirement.
specification_error_found_and_resolved.root_cause_1: Acceptance criteria used flat ids (AC-1 .. AC-16). The checker matches ACs by literal set equality and filters @covers with /^AC-[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$/, so flat ids could never match. The skill reference specification-format.md prescribes AC-XXX-001-01, and the checker own fixtures use AC-TEST-001-01.
specification_error_found_and_resolved.root_cause_2: Tests carried no JSDoc annotations. The extractor only recognises a /** */ block immediately preceding a test/it/describe call and requires @test REQ-... plus @intent.
specification_error_found_and_resolved.resolution: User authorized option A. All 16 AC ids were rewritten to the canonical AC-153-<req>-<nn> form, derived from each AC own requirement: field rather than guessed, and every REQ -> AC relationship was verified preserved. Mandatory @test/@intent/@covers JSDoc was added to all sprint test blocks.

remaining_structural_gap_is_out_of_code_.criteria: (ops) commit-lint is configured as a required status check
remaining_structural_gap_is_out_of_code_.reason: Requires a repository administrator to change GitHub branch protection. The specification declares test_type: manual and states it is outside code acceptance scope. No automated assertion can prove it; fabricating one would be a false pass. Deferred to manual UAT in Phase 6 CLOSE.

remaining_intent_gaps_are_pre_existing.detail: Every one is an @intent annotation missing from a suite pre-dating this sprint (stream-message-service 36, dingtalk-stream 31, openai-compatible 14, and so on). None belongs to issue #153 and no sprint suite contributes one. Retro-fitting @intent across ~281 unrelated assertions would be a large unreviewed change outside this sprint write scope, so it is reported rather than silently absorbed.

analysis.why_score_is_zero_not_partial: calculateScore blends requirementCoverage 30 + acCoverage 25 + testIntent 20 + edgeCaseCoverage 15 + dataValidity 10, with no partial-credit path. Missing @intent in files this sprint does not own suppresses the testIntent dimension, so a repository-wide FAIL is the correct tool output even though sprint-scope alignment is complete.

verification_evidence.automated_suites: 91 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed across seven sprint suites, including a real release-it integration release in a throwaway clone with the live repository VERSION verified unchanged.
verification_evidence.live_repo_integrity: VERSION == package.json == 1.10.0 before and after every test run

phase_2_disposition: Phase 2 (frozen execution) was not entered as a separate frozen pass because the raw verdict is FAIL for reasons outside sprint scope. No test was deleted, skipped, or weakened to change it: the single skip is the dependency-capability guard, which reports SKIPPED with a concrete reason by design. Reporting FAIL honestly is required by the skill anti-pattern rules.
